title: Sleeve checks and no smartglasses: South Korea races to protect all-important university exams against AI
summary: South Korea has been gripped by revelations of AI-aided cheating, just days before more than half a million students are to sit high-stakes entrance exams The integrity of South Korea’s career-defining university entrance exam has been thrown into doubt after the top scorer in a recent professional exam admitted using a concealed camera and AI to cheat. On Thursday, more than half a million people, mostly school students, are due to sit the exam, known as the suneung, at 1,312 centres across the country. The exam runs for a gruelling eight hours over a single day and determines which university a candidate can attend and, in turn, their future prospects. Continue reading...

title: White House withdraws nomination of Heidi Overton to lead FDA
summary: Move to drop Trump ally and prominent abortion opponent comes a day before key Senate health committee vote The White House has dropped its nomination of Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a White House official told the Guardian. Donald Trump nominated Overton – a physician and prominent abortion opponent – in August. Overton has spent most of her professional career working directly for Trump or conservative groups aligned with his agenda. Her nomination in August was seen as a move to bring a stabilizing Trump loyalist to the agency after a tumultous year under Trump’s first FDA commissioner, Marty Makary. Continue reading...
